summary_en: Mizuho Leasing raised its full-year dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending March 2027. Interim dividend per ordinary share increased to ¥29.00 from ¥26.00 announced in May. Full-year dividend per ordinary share revised upward to ¥58.00 from ¥52.00, reflecting strong first-half earnings across domestic and international leasing operations.
title_en: Notice of Upward Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Financial Forecast, Interim Dividend Payment, and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Mizuho Leasing announced an upward revision of its dividend guidance for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, alongside an increase in interim dividend. For ordinary shares, the interim dividend per share was raised to ¥29.00 from ¥26.00 previously announced on May 14, 2026, with a record date of September 30, 2026 and an effective date of December 4, 2026. The full-year dividend per ordinary share was revised upward to ¥58.00 from ¥52.00, comprising an interim dividend of ¥29.00 and a year-end dividend of ¥29.00. The company also issued A-class preferred shares totaling 32 million shares on July 1, 2026, which participate in the same dividend of ¥29.00 per share on an interim basis with a projected full-year dividend of ¥58.00 per share.

The dividend increase reflects strong operational performance through the second quarter of the fiscal year. The company's domestic and international leasing operations showed robust profit growth across all business segments, prompting an upward revision of full-year consolidated earnings guidance. Operating profit was raised by ¥5.0 billion to ¥45.0 billion, ordinary profit by ¥5.0 billion to ¥72.0 billion, and net income attributable to parent company shareholders by ¥5.0 billion to ¥57.0 billion, representing increases of 12.5 percent, 7.5 percent, and 9.6 percent respectively from previous guidance issued on May 14, 2026.
